Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Sotogrande?

Spanish law requires a license for boats over 5m without a skipper. By renting a boat with a skipper, you bypass this requirement entirely. This is ideal for tourists, first-timers, or anyone who wants to enjoy the Mediterranean without paperwork. Plus, you get local knowledge from the skipper — they know the best coves, restaurants and anchorages.
